migration_order: 1. Remove @Deprecated GlowTokens aliases (Didot, Inter, Playfair, terracota, emerald, amber, deepGreen, cyberCyan, etc.)
2. Migrate AppTheme (shared/theme.dart) getters to Token/TypographyTokens equivalents
3. Replace hardcoded fontFamily, Color, EdgeInsets, BorderRadius, BoxShadow with Token/TypographyTokens/Spacing/Radii/AppShadow/OpacityTokens equivalents
4. Deprecate GlowTokens class further (or remove after verification)
5. Evaluate specialized systems (GlowStoreTokens, MensTheme, BellezaLuxeTokens, Academy token system) for potential integration or retention
6. Remove legacy systems only after zero consumers, tests pass, build passes, registry updated
removal_conditions: Governance registry updated (legacy registry entry removed or marked removed)

registry_drift.drift: Does not list some deprecated GlowTokens aliases (Didot, Inter, Playfair, terracota, emerald, amber, deepGreen, cyberCyan, etc.) as legacy; they should be added.
registry_drift.action: Update registry to include these aliases as legacy

registry_drift.drift: Lists Token as source for color but does not list TypographyTokens as source for typography; should be updated.
registry_drift.action: Update registry to include TypographyTokens as source for typography

recommendations: Proceed to P1.3-B — TOKEN CONSOLIDATION IMPLEMENTATION after authorization
Follow the migration order specified in Section 17
Implement bridge strategy for legacy systems during transition
Validate all changes with flutter test, flutter analyze (zero new errors), flutter build web --release
Update governance registries as part of migration
Retain specialized systems (GlowStoreTokens, MensTheme, BellezaLuxeTokens, Academy token system) as adapters unless full consolidation is deemed necessary
Ensure no changes to business logic, navigation, state management, backend, API, database, RAG, or GlowIcon System v1.0
